keyLimits.en: Flat price covering up to 100 employees; 10% discount available with annual commitment.
For companies with 101 to 1,000 employees; price based on company size, usage, and commitment length.

addOns.en: Ashby Analytics: usage-based add-on for advanced reporting, for companies over 100 employees, on top of any ATS plan.
Advanced Scheduling Automation (AI auto-scheduler) and AI Notetaker: paid add-ons.

cautions.en: Foundations pricing is flat per company (up to 100 employees), not per seat: a small team pays the same $400/month as one near the 100-employee ceiling.

capabilities.en: Full applicant tracking system with sourcing, CRM, structured interview scheduling, and offer/approval workflows.
AI-assisted candidate search, AI interview interpretation, and diversity analytics in reporting dashboards.
250+ marketplace integrations plus native Slack, Google Workspace, and Office 365 sync.
eSignature-backed offer templates and approval workflows.

limitations.en: No free plan or published free trial; the entry point is a $400/month flat subscription.
AI Notetaker and advanced scheduling automation are separate paid add-ons, not included by default.
Pricing beyond 100 employees is entirely custom-quoted, with no published rate card.

reason.en: Leading ATS competitor for structured hiring and interview processes.
Overlaps on sourcing and candidate outreach for the same hiring workflow.

unknowns: No explicit free-trial length is published on the pricing page.
